name: What permits are required for a high-end home remodel in areas like Pasadena?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for a high-end home remodel in areas like Pasadena?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a high-end home remodel in Pasadena, various permits are typically required, depending on the scope of work. These commonly include building permits for structural changes, additions, or significant renovations, as well as separate permits for electrical, plumbing, and mechanical systems. Projects involving changes to exterior aesthetics or historical properties may also require design review or historic preservation permits. Opus Builders manages the entire permitting process, ensuring all necessary approvals are obtained from the City of Pasadena to keep your project compliant and on schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: High-end remodels in Pasadena require building, electrical, plumbing, and potentially design review permits; Opus Builders manages the process.
